data.name: Apollos
data.gender_notes: Apollos is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Apollon', derived from 'apellō' (to shine, illuminate). Apollo was the ancient Greek god of the sun, music, poetry, art, prophecy, archery, plague, medicine, and more. In Christianity, Apollos is a mentioned disciple and a leader in the early church. The name Apollos carries the meaning “Sun, Light, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Apollos usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, light, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and wisdom.
data.etymology: Apollos belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Light, Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Apollos total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: אפולוס
in_hebrew.meaning: הוא שדכן של אלוהים, משרתו של ישוע המשיח
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אפולוס הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית, אך משמעותו מתארת את אפולו, אל השמש והמוזיקה והשירה במיתולוגיה היוונית, אך בהקשר של שירות אלוהים ונצרות, משמעות השם אפולוס קשורה לשמש, האור והישועה בישוע המשיח, ופירושו 'הוא שדכן של אלוהים' או 'משרתו של ישוע המשיח', וישועה וגאולה דרך ישוע המשיח.

in_greek.name: Ἀπόλλως
in_greek.meaning: Αἰκός τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἀνήρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Ἀπόλλως προέρχεται ἀπό τὸν Ἀπόλλωνα, τὸν θεὸν τῆς ἡλιακῆς ἀκτινοβολίας καὶ τῆς μουσικῆς στὴν ἑλληνικὴ μυθολογία, ἀλλὰ ἐν τοῖς χριστιανικοῖς κειμένους, δηλώνει τὸν ἀνθρώπινον ὑπηρέτην τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τῆς σωτηρίας ἐν Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ, καὶ ἔχει τὴν σημασία 'αἰκός τοῦ Θεοῦ' ἤ 'ὁ ἀνήρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ', καὶ συνδεδεμένος μετὰ τῆς σωτηρίας καὶ ἀπελευθερώσεως ἐν Χριστῷ.

in_latin.name: Apollos
in_latin.meaning: Minister of God, servant of Jesus Christ
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Apollos derives from the Greek Apollo, the god of the sun, music, and poetry, but in Christian context, it signifies a devoted servant of God and Jesus Christ. The name conveys the meaning of 'minister of God' or 'servant of Jesus Christ', embodying the virtues of service, devotion, and redemption through Christ. Historically, Apollos was a prominent figure in the early Christian church, known for his eloquence and teaching abilities.

in_english.name: Apollos
in_english.meaning: Destroyer, or, one who destroys, a minister of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Apollos originates from the Greek name Ἀπόλλων (Apollon), meaning 'destroyer', but in Christian tradition, it signifies a devoted servant of God. Etymologically derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, Apollos means 'one who destroys' or 'minister of God', reflecting a powerful and devoted servant of Jesus Christ. In the New Testament, Apollos was a prominent early Christian missionary and preacher, known for his eloquence and fervent spirit. The name Apollos symbolizes spiritual growth, devotion, and spreading the teachings of Christ.
